name: sidebar-nav
title: Sidebar Nav
description: The left app-shell sidebar most SaaS dashboards actually ship (Linear, Notion, Vercel): drag its right edge to resize it, or drag past the collapse point and it snaps into a 64px icon-only rail, the same click-the-hamburger toggle works too, with labels shrinking away in place and a hover tooltip standing in for them. A real workspace switcher and search sit up top, grouped links carry a sliding active highlight, a badge count becomes a small dot once collapsed, and the footer is a working presence switcher (Online/Away/Do not disturb/Offline) instead of a static profile card. Switch the frame to "Mobile" to see the same hamburger button open a slide-in drawer over a backdrop instead of collapsing in place.
